bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"
{ echo PROFILE_IPC_SOURCE_DIVERGENCE
for path in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
  echo FILE="$(basename "$path")"
  old="$(mktemp)"
  git show 53451aa78635ba7e94b7db63544e0e7c020d54d7:"$path" > "$old"
  echo BASE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$old" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  diff -u "$old" "$path" | grep -E '^[-+][^-+]' | head -35 || true
  rm -f "$old"
done
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)
} | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
